title: Junior Graphic Designer
note: Fitness equipment brand; asks for 1–3 years of experience.

facts.summary: Junior graphic designer on Rogue's in-house creative team.
facts.duties: Packaging, branding, product graphics such as nameplates and sleeves, print/web production files, signage, and WordPress article pages.
facts.requirements: 1–3 years of experience, plus Illustrator, InDesign and Photoshop, and working knowledge of Figma and WordPress.
facts.apply: Apply through Rogue's Workday site with a portfolio.
